interpretation_limits: Target 1 can buy an underweight account or sell a leveraged account; submitted intents include many deadband no-ops. Actual fills are classified at the next observed open opportunity, using own inventory and fees.
A start-of-quarter regime label is fixed by prior information; it does not describe the sign of the subsequently realized quarter return.
Period returns reset to the prior observed close or initial inventory; period drawdowns are local and are not additive. All periods remain descriptive views of already saved actual strategy paths.
Per-policy attribution is path dependent: after fallback trades, later learned decisions use changed own inventory. No causal effect of a single trade or alternate rule is identified.
Inherited forecast/scoring support is retrospective shared research support, not proof of real-time operational availability.
scope: read-only behavior audit of saved target paths; no fitting, new target selection, counterfactual policy rollout or formal inference

trace_checks.decision_state_reconstruction: initial cash=0, units=1/first open; saved previous intents fill only at immediately following known open; fees and past borrowing included; current close and current borrow excluded at decision; no actual exposure clipping
